title: polyscias cissiflora
intro: Polyscias cissiflora, commonly known as the Polyscias or Variegated Polyscias, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias cissiflora include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic properties.
